negative_snippets:
I recently stayed at this hotel and unfortunately, my experience was not up to standard. Upon arrival, I noticed that the dustbin in the room had not been properly cleaned. Additionally, there was a lizard on the floor, which made the environment feel uncomfortable and unhygienic. To make matters worse, I also spotted a mouse in the room. These cleanliness and pest control issues are unacceptable for any hotel, and they really impacted my stay. I hope the management takes these concerns seriously to ensure a better experience for future guests.
